All Implemented Interfaces:
it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.objects.ObjectCollection<HostedScreen<?>>, it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.objects.ObjectIterable<HostedScreen<?>>, it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.objects.ObjectList<HostedScreen<?>>, it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.Stack<HostedScreen<?>>, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<List<? extends HostedScreen<?>>>, Iterable<HostedScreen<?>>, Collection<HostedScreen<?>>, List<HostedScreen<?>>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<HostedScreen<?>>
public class HostedStack extends it.unimi.dsi.fastutil.objects.ObjectArrayList<HostedScreen<?>>
Navigation stack for one detached window, with the root at the bottom.

Hosted GUI code may call Minecraft's ordinary displayGuiScreen mechanism. While scoped, this stack interprets that request as a child screen, a return to an existing parent, or a request to close the current child. The root stays pinned during navigation. Closing the native window disposes the stack; Window.setUI(HostUI) replaces it with a new root without closing the window. All operations belong on the client thread. Use the window's navigation methods for normal callers rather than mutating this inherited list directly, which would bypass lifecycle bookkeeping.

    • runScoped

      public void runScoped(FrameEvent event, int pixelWidth, int pixelHeight, Consumer<HostedScreen<?>> action)
      Borrows window and screen state, runs an action, then restores it in reverse order.

      Action and navigation failures propagate after scope restoration so the driver can close only the failed window. Navigation is skipped after a failed action because currentScreen may be only partly changed.

      Scope-entry and restoration failures propagate. If screen-scope entry fails, the entered window scopes are still restored. After an action, the mouse override is cleared before restoring the screen scope.

      Parameters:
      event - input buffer supplying pointer coordinates
      pixelWidth - drawable width for HEI coordinate conversion, or -1 if unavailable
      pixelHeight - drawable height for HEI coordinate conversion, or -1 if unavailable
      action - callback operating on the top entry; skipped when empty

    • pushStolen

      public void pushStolen(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiScreen stolen)
